svg.title: Georgia study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Kakheti near Telavi; 2: Kakheti near Kvareli; 3: Kartli near Gori; 4: Imereti near Kutaisi; 5: Racha near Ambrolauri; 6: Samegrelo near Zugdidi; 7: Tbilisi; 8: Batumi; 9: Sukhumi; 10: Rustavi; 11: Poti; 12: Tskhinvali

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
